title: Run gate static checks in parallel with tests, trial tsgo, measure queue vs run time
body:
Outcome: typecheck, lint, task check and rules run in parallel with the test shards inside `npm run gate` (fail-fast: the first failure stops the rest and prints which stage failed), and a measured trial of tsgo for typecheck decides whether to adopt it.
Source: .krn/runs/lead/ci-research/report.md (rank 5; Linear reported -73% typecheck with tsgo, secondary source). Also measure queue time vs run time per gate (rank 6) from Jenkins/attempt evidence at host load 20-25 and record whether host contention is the hidden cost.
Proof: gate duration before/after; a test that a failing parallel stage fails the gate with its name.
